Set up the FANN C library via vcpkg on Windows, ISOLATED and vetted. Security context: Microsoft/vcpkg is a trusted publisher (official C/C++ package manager); the FANN source is already vetted clean this session. Do NOT run anything with system-wide effect beyond a local toolchain, no credentials, no background servers.

Steps:
1. CHECK for a usable C++ compiler FIRST: look for MSVC (cl.exe, Visual Studio, or Build Tools) and for MinGW (WinLibs gcc installed earlier — search common paths). Report what you find.
2. If NO usable C++ compiler exists: STOP. Do NOT download or install Visual Studio / a multi-GB toolchain. Report the blocker and exactly what the user would need (e.g. "VS Build Tools with the C++ workload" or a MinGW on PATH), and stop there.
3. If a compiler IS available: clone https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg into C:\Users\mariu\experiments\vcpkg (NOT a system dir). Bootstrap with the WINDOWS script `bootstrap-vcpkg.bat` (the .sh is Linux — don't use it). Do NOT run `vcpkg integrate install` (system MSBuild integration — skip). Then run `.\vcpkg install fann`. Report the installed artifact paths (headers + .lib/.dll under vcpkg\installed), and disk used.
Report honestly how far it got, any failure output verbatim, and whether it succeeded. Write to C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\exp-fann.md and return a concise summary. Mind RAM/CPU (a build + mesh swarm are running).

handback.t:
FANN installed successfully via vcpkg, but only with the MinGW triplet. The default `.\vcpkg install fann` (x64-windows) fails because there is no MSVC on this machine.

**Compiler check:** No MSVC found (no cl.exe, no vswhere, no Visual Studio or Build Tools directories). MinGW is present: WinLibs gcc 16.2.0 (x86_64-ucrt-posix-seh) at `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\BrechtSanders.WinLibs.POSIX.UCRT_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\mingw64\bin`. It is not on the global PATH, so I prepended it for my own process only.

**What I did:**
- Cloned microsoft/vcpkg (shallow) into `C:\Users\mariu\experiments\vcpkg`.
- Ran `bootstrap-vcpkg.bat -disableMetrics`, which downloaded a signed vcpkg.exe from the official release.
- Did not run `vcpkg integrate install`.
- Nothing system-wide was changed: no installs, no PATH or registry edits, no servers.

**Failure output, verbatim:** `.\vcpkg install fann` with the default triplet gave `error: in triplet x64-windows: Unable to find a valid Visual Studio instance` and `Could not locate a complete Visual Studio instance`. I retried with `.\vcpkg install fann --triplet x64-mingw-dynamic --host-triplet x64-mingw-dynamic` (concurrency capped at 2). That built fann 2023-01-26 in 39 s and ended with "All requested installations completed successfully".

**Artifacts** are under `C:\Users\mariu\experiments\vcpkg\installed\x64-mingw-dynamic\`:
- `include\`: fann.h, floatfann.h, doublefann.h, fixedfann.h, fann_cpp.h, parallel_fann.h and the rest of the headers.
- `lib\`: libfann.dll.a, libfloatfann.dll.a, libdoublefann.dll.a, libfixedfann.dll.a. These are MinGW import libs, not MSVC `.lib` files.
- `bin\`: libfann.dll and the float, double and fixed variants. `debug\` has the same set.
- `share\fann\fann-config.cmake`.

To use it: `g++ -I<installed>\include -L<installed>\lib -lfann`, with `bin\` on PATH at runtime for the DLL.

**Disk:** The vcpkg tree is 626.6 MB. Most of that is its own downloaded tools (cmake 4.4.3, msys2 pkgconf, powershell-core, 7zip) in `vcpkg\downloads`, plus the clone. The installed packages are only 2.95 MB, and the binary cache is 0.65 MB in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\vcpkg`.

**Notes:** The port is LGPL-2.1. The MinGW triplets are community triplets, which vcpkg flags as less likely to succeed, but this one worked. The report is at `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\exp-fann.md`.
